findings.evidence: `rg -n "pushforward_apply|/--" code/TauCeti/AlgebraicGeometry/WeilDivisor.lean` shows the preceding docstring belongs to `pushforward` at line 154, followed directly by `lemma pushforward_apply` at line 160 with no docstring.
findings.fix: Add a short docstring describing it as the explicit unfolding equation for formal pushforward, intended for manual rewriting rather than simp normal form.
findings.issue: `pushforward_apply` is a public unfolding lemma changed by this PR but has no docstring explaining that it is the manual equation for `pushforward f D = D.mapDomain f` after removing `@[simp]`.

findings.evidence: `rg -n "coeff_pushforward|/--" code/TauCeti/AlgebraicGeometry/WeilDivisor.lean` shows `lemma coeff_pushforward` at line 164 immediately after undocumented `pushforward_apply`, with no attached `/-- ... -/`.
findings.fix: Add a docstring stating that the coefficient of the pushed-forward divisor at `y` is the sum of coefficients over the fibre `f x = y`.
findings.issue: `coeff_pushforward` is a public coefficient formula for pushforward but has no docstring, despite being one of the main user-facing theorems in this API section.

summary: The changed public pushforward API leaves two exported lemmas undocumented, including the now-manual unfolding lemma whose intended use is no longer communicated by attributes.
